sources.label: All-in-one personal Morphe patches — Made in Brazil. 100% AI-crafted, tested bef
sources.author: rimixyz
patch_list: Blocks all ad formats (banner, native, interstitial and rewarded), stops Mobile Ads/mediation SDK initialization, and skips UMP ad consent prompts.
Disables Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, Sentry diagnostics, internal analytics tracking, and removes Advertising ID permissions.
Neutralizes the PairIP license check so the re-signed APK can start, without removing its components.
Adds a Local Backup & Restore item to Settings to export/restore local .zip backups (with automatic rollback) and import official MyTherapy Archive CSV history.
Grants the local Plus state the app reads for ad-free access, extra calendar days and the PDF entry point.
